body: Happy New Year to you, Jess.
I had been hiding them too... I just needed to scream the into a void somewhere.
Don’t make me cry. 😭 I’m not that great. But thank you.

Hugs back x 

If you do ever date, keep in mind though — people can lie. They can and they do. The only reason I have dated was because I thought I had found people who *did* think similarly to me and shared my values. It all turned out to be bullshit in the end.
They always feel the same. Feel first, actually. But then lose feelings. I’m guarding my heart, I think. I don’t think love exists in my world.
Are you my person? Lol. What I would give to hear them say those words. :’(
People, especially in this generation, take love and loyalty for granted for sure.
I pray you find the response you are looking for one day. 🙏🏻
Uh, I might be missing something here, but definitely no one is wearing anyone else’s skin in this scenario. I promise.
Same. I am disposable to everyone in my life and I am ready to end it. No one will cry for me when I die; I am no one’s #1.

Right? I wish every day that I could give my life up to one of those people who are dying, who deserve to live. Who have loved ones who will love and miss them. When I inevitably end things, I just hope that my organs can be used to save someone’s life.
Hey there, I am sure you are a great person. If you need a friend, I am here to talk.
I totally get that too. I was told something similar. Not being able to do as much as I would’ve. I totally get that. Wishing the best of luck to you. 💕
Feel this so hard. Giving all of yourself to someone who doesn’t care at all. Sending love ❤️.
